title: 第003章 仙府外围大阵第004章 第三层毒阵
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
地面上，三台天眼卫星持续对准北极上空，二十四小时不间断扫描；地下，数百台无人机和探测机器人在大殿里来回穿梭，收集各种数据；灵能研究团队则围着石门，日夜不停地分析上面的符文。
但结果却不容乐观。
“报告张院士！所有卫星都无法穿透第七层的禁制。”航天指挥中心传来消息，“我们尝试了所有频段的电磁波，包括伽马射线和x射线，全部被禁制反射回来，没有任何回波。”
“报告！深层地震波探测也失败了。第七层的禁制能吸收所有机械波，我们无法获取其内部结构。”
“报告！灵力探测同样无效。凌霄子长老的神识最多只能延伸到第六层的边缘，再往下就会被禁制撕碎。”
指挥中心里，一片愁云惨淡。
这是华夏联盟成立以来，科技第一次遭遇如此彻底的失败。
以前，无论是面对金丹、元婴还是化神修士，科技都能找到应对的方法。但现在，面对第七层的上古禁制，他们所有的探测手段，全部失效了。
“这不可能。”苏晚皱着眉头，“任何禁制都不可能完全屏蔽所有能量。除非……它不是我们认知中的禁制。”
“你的意思是？”张德华问道。
“我的意思是，它可能是一种力场。”苏晚解释道，“一种我们从未见过的、能扭曲空间的引力场。所有进入这个力场的物质和能量，都会被扭曲、吸收，甚至直接湮灭。”
“如果真是这样的话，那我们的任何探测手段，都不可能穿透它。”
所有人都沉默了。
扭曲空间的引力场。
这已经超出了现代物理学的范畴。
十万年前的上古文明，竟然已经掌握了如此先进的技术？
这简直是天方夜谭。
就在这时，凌霄子突然脸色一变，猛地抬头看向仙府深处的方向。
“怎么了？”张德华问道。
“我感觉到了。”凌霄子的声音带着一丝恐惧，“第七层里面，有东西在盯着我们。”

“那东西……很可怕。非常可怕。”
他的身体不由自主地微微颤抖，额头上渗出了冷汗。
活了五千年，凌霄子从未如此恐惧过。
即便是当年面对燃烧元婴的清虚真人，他也没有这样的感觉。
那种感觉，就像是一只蝼蚁，在面对一头沉睡的巨龙。
只要巨龙稍微动一下手指，就能将它碾得粉碎。
张德华的脸色也变得凝重起来。
能让化神中期的凌霄子感到如此恐惧的东西，到底是什么？
难道……就是那股万倍于化神的能量源？
“加大警戒力度。”张德华沉声下令，“所有机甲进入战斗状态，无人机二十四小时巡逻。任何人不得擅自离开大殿。”
“是！”
接下来的几天，仙府里的气氛越来越压抑。
越来越多的人感觉到了那股来自深处的窥视感。
晚上睡觉的时候，很多人都会做噩梦，梦见一个巨大的黑影，在黑暗中静静地看着他们。
一些心理素质差的士兵，甚至开始出现幻觉和精神崩溃的症状。
而灵能研究团队那边，也遇到了巨大的困难。
石门上的符文阵法，远比他们想象的复杂。
这些符文不是独立存在的，而是相互关联，形成了一个巨大的、动态的能量循环系统。只要动其中一个符文，整个阵法就会发生变化，甚至会触发杀阵。
传统的破阵方法，比如用灵力硬冲、找阵眼，在这里完全行不通。
几天下来，研究团队没有任何进展。

“不行，这样下去不是办法。”苏晚对张德华说，“我们必须换一种思路。”
“既然传统方法不行，那我们就用大数据。”
“把所有符文的能量波动、位置、形态全部输入超级计算机，让计算机模拟整个阵法的能量循环，找出它的规律和安全节点。”
张德华点了点头：“好。立刻调动天河十号超级计算机的全部算力，支持灵能研究团队。”
当天晚上，天河十号超级计算机全面启动。
content_en:
On the ground, three Sky Eye satellites continue to focus on the North Pole, scanning 24 hours a day; underground, hundreds of drones and detection robots shuttle back and forth in the hall, collecting various data; the psychic research team surrounds the stone gate, analyzing the runes on it day and night.
But the results are not optimistic.
"Report to Academician Zhang! All satellites are unable to penetrate the seventh layer of restrictions." News came from the Space Command Center, "We tried electromagnetic waves in all frequency bands, including gamma rays and x-rays, and they were all reflected back by the restrictions without any echo."
"Report! Deep seismic wave detection has also failed. The restriction on the seventh layer can absorb all mechanical waves, and we cannot obtain its internal structure."
"Report! The spiritual power detection is also ineffective. Elder Ling Xiaozi's spiritual consciousness can only extend to the edge of the sixth level at most, and will be torn apart by restrictions any further."
The command center was filled with gloom and gloom.
This is the first time since the establishment of the China Alliance that technology has suffered such a complete failure.
In the past, technology could find a way to deal with it, no matter whether it was faced with golden elixirs, Yuanying or god-transformation monks. But now, facing the ancient restrictions on the seventh floor, all their detection methods have failed.
"This is impossible." Su Wan frowned, "No restriction can completely block all energy. Unless... it is not a restriction in our understanding."
"What do you mean?" Zhang Dehua asked.
"What I mean is that it may be a force field." Su Wan explained, "A gravitational field that we have never seen before that can distort space. All matter and energy entering this force field will be distorted, absorbed, or even directly annihilated."
"If this is the case, then none of our detection methods will be able to penetrate it."
Everyone was silent.
A gravitational field that distorts space.
This is beyond the scope of modern physics.
How could an ancient civilization a hundred thousand years ago have mastered such advanced technology?
This is simply a fantasy.
At this moment, Ling Xiaozi's expression suddenly changed, and he suddenly raised his head and looked towards the depths of the Immortal Mansion.
"What's wrong?" Zhang Dehua asked.
"I feel it." Ling Xiaozi's voice was filled with fear, "There is something staring at us on the seventh floor."
"That thing... was scary. Very scary."
His body trembled slightly involuntarily, and cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
In five thousand years of living, Ling Xiaozi had never been so scared.
Even when he faced Master Qingxu who burned Nascent Soul, he didn't feel this way.
It felt like an ant facing a sleeping dragon.
As long as the dragon moves its fingers a little, it can be crushed to pieces.
Zhang Dehua's expression also became solemn.
What is it that can make Ling Xiaozi, who is in the middle stage of becoming a god, feel so scared?
Could it be... that it's that energy source that's ten thousand times more powerful than the Transformation God?
"Intensify the vigilance." Zhang Dehua ordered in a deep voice, "All mechas are in combat mode, and drones are patrolling 24 hours a day. No one is allowed to leave the hall without permission."
"Yes!"
In the next few days, the atmosphere in the Immortal Mansion became increasingly depressing.
More and more people are feeling that sense of peeping from the depths.
When sleeping at night, many people have nightmares about a huge black shadow watching them quietly in the darkness.
Some soldiers with poor psychological quality even began to experience hallucinations and symptoms of mental breakdown.
The psychic research team also encountered huge difficulties.
The rune formation on the stone gate was far more complicated than they imagined.
These runes do not exist independently, but are interrelated, forming a huge and dynamic energy circulation system. As long as one of the runes is touched, the entire formation will change, and even the killing formation will be triggered.
Traditional methods of breaking the formation, such as using spiritual power to charge hard and finding the formation's eyes, are completely eliminated here.Doesn't work.
For several days, the research team made no progress.
"No, this is not the way to go." Su Wan said to Zhang Dehua, "We must change our thinking."
"Since traditional methods don't work, then we will use big data."
"Input all the energy fluctuations, positions, and shapes of all the runes into the supercomputer, and let the computer simulate the energy cycle of the entire array to find its rules and safe nodes."
Zhang Dehua nodded: "Okay. Immediately mobilize all the computing power of the Tianhe-10 supercomputer to support the psychic research team."
That night, the Tianhe-10 supercomputer was fully launched.
